request.subject: UNIT:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Remove the bow across his belly and the quiver of arrows on his shoulder. Make his bright red tabard bigger, a plain solid bright red with no emblem, covering his chest and belly down to his knees. Make the belts, gloves and boots dark slate grey and draw the mouth as a tiny dark line. Keep the huge warhammer over his shoulder, the steel helmet, the steel armour, face, pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under his feet.
